excerpt: Agent Store is a directory of AI agents that live as phone numbers you text in Messages: no app, no account. Free to browse; 10 categories.
content:
Agent Store, launched on Product Hunt as Text Agent Store, is a directory of AI agents that you use by sending a text message. Each agent has a real phone number, so it sits in your Messages app next to your other contacts. You browse by category or by what is trending, tap Text on a listing, and Messages opens a thread with that agent, pre-filled. There is nothing to download and no account to make. You can also text the store's own number, +1 (424) 278-0248, to explore it over text and get a weekly message about new agents.

On 14 October 2026 the site listed 145 agents and 15 infrastructure providers across ten categories, including Productivity, Business, Travel, Finance, Health & Fitness and Careers. Agents are mostly free to text, the maker says, and some sell in-agent purchases or subscriptions. Builders can submit an agent through a form; the site says every agent is reviewed before it goes live, within 24 hours. A featured "billboard" spot at the top of the store is sold by bidding and stays with the buyer until someone pays more.

The store was made by Stanley Virgint, whose Product Hunt headline reads founder and CEO of the travel agent Soar, with Patrick Sullivan, co-founder and CTO of the messaging company Linq, and Jayanth Sidamsety. It launched on Product Hunt on 17 September 2026 and finished #3 for the day with 282 upvotes and 36 comments.

We have not tested Agent Store ourselves. This page brings together its official site, submit page and privacy policy, its Product Hunt launch page and the official pages of comparable directories, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.summary_short: Directory of AI agents you use by texting a phone number, with no app or account

Trying an agent without installing an app or making an account
Getting a weekly text about newly listed agents
Listing your own texting agent to reach more users

paragraphs: Stanley Virgint says a wave of texting agents is coming, each with its own use and personality, but there was no good way to find them beyond spotting one on X and bookmarking it. Agent Store is the answer: one place to browse agents that live as phone numbers rather than apps.

Virgint said the directory had grown to 137 agents in its first three months, from travel companions and matchmakers to recruiters and health coaches, and invited builders to submit theirs for free distribution. In replies the maker added that agents are vetted by people before listing and that the team hand-picks new agents every Monday.

fit: like to use AI through text messages rather than new apps
build a texting agent and want a place to list it
use an iPhone, since the store and many agents are built around iMessage
not_fit: want one assistant that does everything: this is a directory of separate agents
need detail on how each agent handles your messages: that is up to each agent, not the store
want published review criteria: the submit page says agents are reviewed but does not list the checks

pricing.intro: Browsing Agent Store costs nothing and needs no account. Agents set their own prices: the maker says most are free to text and some offer in-agent purchases or subscriptions. The site lists no subscription for users.

plans.name: Browse and text agents
plans.detail: Your usual carrier messaging charges may apply; individual agents may charge

plans.name: Featured billboard spot (for builders)
plans.detail: Top-of-store placement that stays yours until someone pays more

notes: Listing an agent through the submit form has no fee mentioned on the page.
Payments go through Stripe, according to the privacy policy.

alternatives.intro: Agent Store is unusual in listing agents you text. These are well-known places to find AI assistants and bots, checked on 14 October 2026.

items.name: GPT Store (ChatGPT)
items.what: OpenAI's directory of custom GPTs inside ChatGPT
items.starts_at: Free sign-up; see ChatGPT's pricing page
items.difference: Much larger catalogue, but every GPT runs inside ChatGPT and needs an account, rather than living in your Messages app.

items.name: Poe
items.what: Chat app with many AI models and user-made bots
items.difference: Bots live in one app you install or open on the web, not as phone numbers.

items.name: There's An AI For That
items.what: Large directory of AI tools sorted by task
items.difference: Covers web apps and tools of every kind; it is a search directory, not a way to start texting an agent.

liked: Using AI the way you already text people
asked: Whether texting agents costs anything (most are free; some sell in-agent purchases or subscriptions, the maker said)
How low-quality or spam agents are kept out (people review each one, the maker said)
How to find the right agent (browse the site, or text the store's number)
Whether builders will get analytics on discovery (the maker said custom tracking is coming)

pros: No app, no download and no account to try an agent
Agents sorted into ten categories with trending and editorial picks
Can be explored over text through the store's own number
Free listing for builders, reviewed within 24 hours according to the site
Privacy policy says it stores only a salted hash of your phone number
cons: No published review criteria for listed agents
Each agent has its own pricing and data practices
No operating company or postal address named on the site or privacy policy
Builder analytics were still promised, not live, at launch

posts.author: Stanley
posts.text: The maker announcing a directory of AI agents you can text on iOS, asking people to tag or submit missing agents.

faq.a: A directory of AI agents that each have a real phone number. You find one on imessage.store, tap Text, and chat with it in your Messages app.
Browsing is free and needs no account. The maker says most agents are free to text and some offer in-agent purchases or subscriptions.

faq.q: How are agents checked before they are listed?
faq.a: The site says every agent is reviewed before it goes live, within 24 hours. On Product Hunt the maker said a group of people vets each one and checks basic safety and usability.

faq.q: How do I list my own agent?
faq.a: Use the submit form at imessage.store/submit with your agent's icon, name, tagline, category, website and a contact email. A phone number is needed only to appear in the iOS app.

faq.q: Does Agent Store read my messages?
faq.a: Its privacy policy says it never sees your Messages or contacts and keeps only a salted one-way hash of your phone number plus its last two digits. Each agent you text handles your messages under its own terms.
The GPT Store inside ChatGPT, Poe and There's An AI For That help you find AI assistants and tools, but none of them list agents you simply text.
